scope: Bounded stationary hydrostatic roundoff correction, not completion of N7-B

correction.stationarity: Both cell momenta and both momenta of every adjacent face endpoint must equal zero exactly.
correction.path_scale: max over adjacent directional endpoints of abs(G*Gamma)*h*max(h,abs(eta))
correction.bound: 64*epsilon(wp)*path_scale/spacing for the normal momentum component only
correction.exclusions: No correction for any nonzero cell/endpoint momentum; no scalar flux modification; no CFL modification.

controls.comparison: Bitwise candidate/HEAD result.bin and composition.bin for every slow-motion and nonequilibrium case; actual one/four-thread equality separately.
controls.equilibrium_matrix: All original 90 N7-B equilibrium cases, unchanged states and tolerances, strict and optimized.
